entries.en: Drove them tanks worth millions, and now what? Look at me!
entries.ro: Am condus tancuri de milioane, și acum ce? Uită-te la mine!

entries.en: Choom, I know. We all lost somethin'.
entries.ro: Choom, știu. Toți am pierdut ceva.

entries.en: Yeah. Ain't nobody sponsor no implant for me, though.
entries.ro: Da. Dar nu-mi sponsorizează nimeni niciun implant.

entries.en: See, now, I heard somethin' different from Trav.
entries.ro: Păi, eu am auzit altceva de la Trav.

entries.en: Oh yeah? What, so you mad now?
entries.ro: Aha, da? Deci acum ești supărat?
